leadText:
Karena (Japanese: キクヨ Kikuyo) is a character of the day who appeared in Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!.

Karena, alongside her granddaughter Daniela, is the owner of a Day Care close to Nacrene City. When , and arrived at the Day Care, they found a group of schoolchildren rebelling against their teacher for not allowing them to keep . Karena helped the children to keep Trubbish by revealing that Trubbish loses its bad odor once it befriends a person. 

In the end, she gave Ash a Pokémon Egg as a reward for all his efforts in helping the children.
